parameters.name: MatchType
parameters.description:
The name matching strategy when querying by name. Valid values:

- fuzzy: fuzzy match.
- exact: exact match.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The load balancing name. You can query by name.

parameters.name: OrderBy
parameters.description: The sort field. Currently, only sorting by ID is supported. id indicates ascending order by ID, and -id indicates descending order by ID. The ID value is positively correlated with the creation time. If this parameter is not specified, the default sort order is descending by ID.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number settings for the paging query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for the paging query. Valid values: 1 to 500.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the site ID.
